data.one_liner: Native iOS 26 UI components for Flutter, with Flutter replicas on Android.
data.what_it_does: Veneer provides real UIKit bars, sheets, glass effects and composers that stay in sync with Flutter layout. On iOS 26+ it renders natively; on older iOS and Android it renders Flutter replicas that match the native look.
use_when: You need native iOS 26 UI elements like tab bars, navigation bars, sheets, glass effects, or native composers.
You want a single codebase that works on iOS 26+ and Android with matching UI.
You need native UIKit interactions such as gestures, accessibility and animations.
You want to avoid platform views per widget for performance.
avoid_when: You target web, desktop or older iOS versions without iOS 26 SDK.
You need a fully cross‑platform UI kit that works on all platforms without native dependencies.
You are building a library that must be pure Dart with no native code.
strengths: Real native UIKit components with true glass effects and animations.
Single native overlay keeps Flutter and native UI in sync every frame.
Flutter widgets control native UI declaratively, no platform view per widget.
Provides matching Flutter replicas for older iOS and Android.
weaknesses: Not supported on web or desktop; requires dart:ffi.
Requires iOS 26 SDK and Xcode 26+ to build native parts.
Only works on iOS 26+ and Android; older iOS uses Flutter replicas.
data.setup_notes: Add veneer to pubspec. Requires Xcode 26+ and iOS 26 SDK. Set iOS deployment target 15.0+. No Android setup needed. No build_runner or codegen.

alternatives.name: cupertino_ui
alternatives.why_pick_it: Provides Cupertino widgets for iOS, but without native UIKit integration or glass effects; use if you need pure Dart Cupertino UI.
